question: Can a small trained factual outcome-dependent write-admission gate prevent interference of actually executed action-consequence associations in the original TTT 16x16 fast matrix, and exceed the strongest conventional GRU, classical rehearsal, surprise, random/adaptive write and source-null controls on an unseen distractor distribution?

task.world: Eight independent QR-orthonormal 16-d continuous sensor contexts, each has fixed latent tanh-Gaussian 16-d vector physical action-effect; four presentations of 8 factual executed ±1 target actions then 32 distractor contexts each with a unique novel action-effect (each actually executed ±1), plus exactly ONE actual factual query action/outcome per world for training; no latent effects or imagined alternative outcomes fed to any learner.
task.query_context: uniform one of eight targets revealed only when final query is decided; no future target identity available to gate at write time
task.observable_per_event: [continuous context_key, executed_action ±1, actually observed outcome delta vector]
task.normalization: value_to_memory = executed_action * observed_sensor_delta; model reconstructs result = action_query * memory(context_key)

ood.distractor_overlap: random normalized 16-vector with 2.0x expected target-subspace component; normalize after projection

task.query_real_action: random ±1 independent of the unseen physical effect; only actually selected query outcome is used to train, no future query known during writes
task.source_validation: SHA256 pinned on first execution. All arms identical original FIT action/outcome opportunities and heldout evaluation queries. OOD consumed exactly once per frozen model seed after FIT/val training.

models.candidate: Original TTT fast update with trainable sigmoid gate of [1, ||current fast read||, 1-cosine(prediction, observed causal effect), count_normalized]. Uses read-before-write and only prior fast state + completed factual outcome; 4 scalar parameters, clamp sigmoid avoiding arbitrary future information; train end-to-end on actually executed query outcome only.
models.original_always_write: Original P65 equation with eta=0.5, all same facts, no training
models.fixed_surprise_write: same capacity/eta, gate=1 only when ||actual outcome effect - fast read|| > train-split median threshold, threshold fixed using FIT-only factual residuals, no OOD tuning
models.fixed_novelty_rehearsal: gate=1 iff ||fast_read|| > FIT-derived threshold or within first 32 factual events; explicit 32-event prefix heuristic is privileged phase knowledge and labelled oracle if present
models.random_write: same 16x16 matrix, Bernoulli gating at FIT-derived acceptance rate with separate frozen seed; not seeded by OOD outcomes
models.classical_equal_budget: 8 most recent factual key/value pairs at 256 scalar floats, nearest key cosine readout; no target phase knowledge
models.classical_fixed_read_write: bounded 256 scalar fast matrix, fixed learned FIT-only scalar gate calibration on factual residuals and read norms, non-neural conventional control
models.GRU: fully train 16+1+16 raw factual vector sequence plus final context and executed query action, hidden dimension 16 then 16-d output; same training query labels and index plan, seed, 400 AdamW updates. Report parameter count, training time and validation plateau; parameter/FLOP parity not established
models.wrong_credit: candidate trained with independently redrawn unrelated executed action identities while preserving actual outcomes (non-invertible); factual query action and outcome unchanged
models.oracle_skip: phase-known exact prefix/distractor skip, privileged upper bound not deployable or fair competitor

primary_metric: Unfamiliar OOD query outcome MSE on one actually executed query per world, same physical outcomes and seed across all arms; report final target-effect MAE and early/late factual memory decay on source-free negative.

frozen_gate.no_oracle_leak: no query identity available before writes; phase oracle excluded from strong admissible baseline
frozen_gate.fully_trained_comparator_plateau: GRU validation MSE last80 delta <=0.005 each seed

negative.real_action_credit_erased: same data redrawn independent action identities, no latent target labels
negative.orthogonal_distractors: source-free extra negative, verify no interference
negative.cold: torch weights_only tensor persistence and exact replay

stop: Preserve all unqualified, zero, negative; no retune on viewed validation heldout; single fresh authored DEV OOD cohort; frozen threshold remains even when no candidate improvement; do not call any authored DEV SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
